name: Transport loads
summary: Wheels beat backs. Shopping carts, wheelbarrows, bike trailers and garden wagons carry far more than a pack. Big wheels roll over rough ground, so take them from bicycles and wheelchairs rather than small casters. For powered hauling, mobility scooters and e-bikes have motors, batteries and controllers sized to move a person and a load.

parts.why: Wheels and bearings from bikes, carts and chairs
Frames from bikes, carts and furniture
Straps and tie-downs to secure the load
A plywood deck for the cart bed
Hub motors from e-bikes and scooters for a powered cart

tips: Keep the load low and over the axle so the cart doesn’t tip or drag on your arms.
Solid tyres can’t puncture; air tyres ride better. Carry a patch kit.
Grease or oil wheel bearings. Dry ones drag and wear out.
